title: Computation of the Business Return Reversal
content:
**Which return and which earning.** For a Northgate+ Business membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the return this Business schedule settles is the most recent return recorded on the member's Northgate orders, the one with the latest return date and, among returns of the same date, the one recorded first; the earning it reverses is the Northgate Cash earning that points to the returned line, and when no such return is recorded or no earning points to that line, nothing is reversed.

**Amount.** The Business return reversal is the reversal share multiplied by one less the relief fraction, rounded half up to the cent. The reversal share is the earned amount multiplied by the merchandise refunded on the return, divided by the earning's basis (the earning basis recorded on that earning). The relief fraction is zero.

**Owed.** A reversal is owed on the return this schedule settles when the earning basis recorded on the Northgate Cash earning that points to its line differs from that line's kept-units basis, and otherwise nothing is reversed. The kept-units basis is the line's net amount multiplied by the units kept (the units bought less every unit refunded without a return on the line), divided by the units bought and rounded half up to the cent, less the merchandise refunded on every return of the line. A line's net amount is the amount charged for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount. Each return record reverses cash at most once, and nothing is reversed when nothing was refunded.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical line of 10 units, net amount 500.00, earning 10.00 recorded on a basis of 500.00)**

```
return of 4 units refunding 200.00
  kept-units basis: 500.00 multiplied by 10, divided by 10, less 200.00, that is 300.00
  recorded basis 500.00 differs from 300.00, so a reversal is owed
  reversal share: 10.00 multiplied by 200.00, divided by 500.00, that is 4.00
  reversal: 4.00 multiplied by one less zero, that is 4.00
```

| Case on the same hypothetical line | Reversal |
|---|---|
| the earning was recorded on a basis of 300.00 | nothing, the bases agree |
| the return refunded nothing | nothing |
